filters.event_types:
Which Discourse event group fires this workflow. The webhook only subscribes to the chosen group (Discourse filters server-side), and deliveries are re-checked at runtime against the X-Discourse-Event-Type header. Choose 'All Events' to fire on every event group.
- All Events: every event Discourse emits
- Topic: topic_created, topic_edited, topic_destroyed, topic_recovered
- Post: post_created, post_edited, post_destroyed, post_recovered
- User: user_created, user_approved, user_updated, user_logged_in
- Group / Category / Tag: created, updated, destroyed for each
- Reviewable / Notification / Like / User Promoted: their respective events
